title: PDF download uses the same range-based filename map with a .pdf extension
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the report with data.
steps: 1. Set the range to This Month and choose "Download (PDF)"; note the filename.
2. Repeat for one other preset and a Custom range.
expected: 1. The file follows the same range-to-filename map as the CSV, with a .pdf extension — for example, sales-by-customer-this_month.pdf, sales-by-customer-custom.pdf.
